    The basic algebra as a full corner #

    For a complete set f_s of primitive orthogonal idempotents of A, choose one representative f_r in each class of f_s A ≅ f_t A and put e = Σ f_r. Then e is full (AeA = A, in the form IsFull), and over an algebraically closed field eAe is split basic. This is the first step of Lemma 3.1.

    The representative choice and the corner idempotents are adapted from LargeIndecomposable/Foundations/BasicCorner.lean of multiplicative-bases-deformations, commit 7b9f39f221d8a420a1531f487a3b93ae6d26ce85.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
